summary: MOONSHOT_BASE_URL fell through to the openai-compatible provider as an empty string, failing every llm-enrich with TypeError: Invalid URL
evidence: provider.ts used 'env.MOONSHOT_BASE_URL ?? "https://api.moonshot.ai/v1"'; .env.example ships 'MOONSHOT_BASE_URL=' blank on purpose and process.loadEnvFile reads that as "", which ?? passes through. Fixed to ||. Reproduced by run-once --step=llm-enrich, which logged 'llm-enrich failed err: Invalid URL' before the fix and succeeded after.

summary: RULES_METHOD is the literal 'rules@1' while CLASSIFIER_VERSION is 2 — the N in rules@N no longer names the classifier that produced the row
evidence: packages/food/src/classifiers/shared.ts:12 hardcodes RULES_METHOD = "rules@1"; packages/food/src/classify.ts:54 has CLASSIFIER_VERSION = 2. Observed in the db after a fresh enrich of wb-4021: recipe_enrichment.classifier_version = 2, every label row method = 'rules@1'. Not currently breaking — writeEnrichment's method-scoped delete keys off the 'llm:%' prefix, not the version — but the method column cannot answer which classifier wrote a row, and any future version-aware cleanup would orphan these.
